prompt:
The same Berlin corner, vertical frame, wide. The young man in the navy blue
polo shirt and beige chinos stands still on the grey pavement slabs at the
kerb, seen from behind, waiting at a pedestrian traffic light on a bare grey pole, its
black housing holding two round lenses, the upper one lit and glowing an
even plain red. On the road beside him the same cyclist rides into the
crossing, seen from behind: the BRIGHT YELLOW waterproof jacket, the dark
grey bicycle, and above the collar a DARK GREY CYCLING HELMET
with short steel grey hair at the neck below it. The helmet, the grey neck
and the yellow jacket are the whole of what identifies him at this distance. The
pale cream facade and three or four black city bicycles leaning against the wall, well spaced along the street. Daylight,
overcast and flat.
